Name: Pet Dog Bone and Ghost Bone
Author: TENKAITENSHI
Description: Introducing the Bone Dog mod for Stardew Valley! This unique addition showcases a Bone Dog in vibrant shades of pink, blue, and green. A special feature of this mod is the Bone Dog's ability to transform into a ghostly form while running, maintaining its distinct color scheme. This mod is fully compatible with all dog breeds in the game, offering a seamless integration. Players can easily configure the Bone Dog settings via the generic menu. Currently, this mod provides 8 distinct assets to enhance gameplay aesthetics, with a promise of further expansion. We are continuously working on refining and introducing more versions to cater to the diverse interests of our players. We'd love to hear from you! Feel free to share your creative ideas for upcoming pets. We appreciate community input as we strive to make the Stardew Valley experience even more engaging and enjoyable.
